However, in the Antihypertensive and Lipid-Lowering Treat- ment to Prevent Heart Attack Trial (ALLHAT)1 the doxazosin arm of the study was terminated early due to an increased inci- dence of heart failure in patients receiving doxazosin compared with those receiving chlortalidone and alpha blockers are now only recommended for third-line therapy unless indicated for an- other reason. 1.
